# AWMC shoreline sample

`shoreline.geojson` selects the first two unchanged features (`OBJECTID` 1 and 2)
from https://github.com/AWMC/geodata/blob/master/Physical%20Data/shoreline/shoreline.geojson,
retrieved November 5, 2026 at 21:42 UTC. Original properties, coordinates and
CRS84 metadata are retained. Full source SHA-256:
`1497761447e0c11d01f50d3795647494d554b7d492b2f9ca64385d5da2a69212`.

Ancient World Mapping Center, with modifications to OpenStreetMap data.
ODbL 1.0, as stated in https://github.com/AWMC/geodata/blob/master/README.md.
`TIMEPERIOD` uses source codes; tests keep the records undated rather than
inventing numeric dates from those codes. No editorial approval is implied.
